title: An unknown severity, status, scope or flag value is silently dropped: sev=severe or status=Overdue returns the whole list as if filtered

where: src/app/api/collector/list/route.ts:26-37 (sev, status, scope fall back to no filter); src/app/api/officer/grievances/route.ts:30-35 (flag, sev); against the rule in src/lib/collector/filters.ts:1-5

area: Officer overview feedback / officer PDF briefing
title: The officer console feedback (and the PDF sentence "The Collector verified N reports and returned M for rework in this period") is built from only the 8 newest decisions, counts a reject as rework and a bare resolve as a verified report
root_cause: The briefing derives counts from a display list capped at 8 instead of a COUNT; reject is grouped with reopen as returned.
where: src/lib/officer/data.ts:247 (collectorFeedback limit OFFICER.feedbackItems = 8, departments.ts:83); src/components/officer/format.ts:37,55 (ok/back from ov.feedback)

title: An officer approve never reaches the Collector console: the case stays "Under review" (in that status chip, not Assigned or In progress) and its case page shows no step, while the officer shows In action and the citizen is told it was approved

where: src/lib/collector/effective.ts:47-50 (status = pipeline status unless a Collector decision); src/lib/collector/intel.ts incident() has no officer_steps; src/lib/complaint-progress.ts:69

title: The officer's search and list filter find nothing when the text has '_' or '%' (e.g. 'bin_50', '50% full'): the backslash escapes are sent without an ESCAPE clause, which SQLite (the AWS store) does not honour
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main/tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/officer-day && node p2-file.mjs "garbage|waste|debris" "Solid Waste" "bin_50% full" && node p9-search.mjs 2026-954FHS
root_cause: MySQL's default LIKE escape is backslash, SQLite has none
where: src/lib/officer/data.ts:408-411 (like = '%' + q with \\ before % _ \\; 'LIKE ?' without ESCAPE), src/lib/aws/dialect.ts (no LIKE/ESCAPE handling)
